hypothesis: Do causal second differences predict heldout quadratic next-step delta signs better than causal first differences?
data: At t in 4..14, only observations t-4..t for predictors. Label uses raw future delta at t+1, evaluator only. Development jitter amplitudes 1 and 2 and offset17; heldout amplitude3 offset79.
classification: SECOND_ORDER_GAIN iff second_order quadratic accuracy>=0.68 and advantage vs first_lag >=0.05 and xorshift accuracy<=0.60; PARTIAL iff quadratic advantage>=0.03 otherwise NEGATIVE
controls: No heldout training or future feature access
claim_limit: Synthetic binary next-step prediction; no generalization claim beyond tested generators.
